h1: Plumber in Lynn, MA — North Shore boiler & water heater specialist
tagline: Lynn's older housing stock, modern plumbing answers.
meta_desc: Plumber serving Lynn, MA — boilers, water heaters, gas, emergencies. Owner-operated, licensed and insured. Same-day service most days. Call 781-820-4592.
intro: Lynn has the densest stock of pre-war and triple-decker housing on the North Shore. That means cast iron drains, lead-to-galvanized water mains, and old boilers running well past their service life. We work Lynn weekly — most emergency calls on the North Shore come from this side of the line.

local_hooks.b: Multi-family buildings throughout Lynn share waste stacks and old plumbing that hasn't been touched in decades. We've done full re-pipes and sectional repairs in dozens of these buildings.
1970s and 1980s cast iron boilers are still common in Lynn. Some are worth saving, many are not — we tell you straight.

local_hooks.h: Hard water means short water heater life
local_hooks.b: Lynn's water hardness shortens tank life. Tankless conversions and water-treatment options make sense for some homes — we'll quote both.

h1: Plumber in Revere, MA — coastal salt-air water heater specialist
tagline: Revere homes face the ocean. Your plumbing should be ready.
meta_desc: Plumber serving Revere, MA — coastal salt-air water heater corrosion, boilers, gas, emergencies. Owner-operated, licensed. Call 781-820-4592 — Shane answers.
intro: Revere is a coastal town — and coastal towns chew through water heaters and outdoor plumbing faster than inland markets. Salt air corrodes power-vent terminations, copper supply lines, and tank exteriors. We service Revere weekly and stock the parts that the coast eats through.

local_hooks.b: Power-vent terminations, condensate drains, and exterior gas piping corrode 2–3x faster on the coast. We use marine-grade fasteners and inspect the exterior side annually.

local_hooks.h: Older Beachmont and Point of Pines housing
local_hooks.b: Pre-war coastal cottages, many converted to year-round homes, often have plumbing that doesn't match their current use. We re-pipe and update without ripping the place apart.
Many Revere two- and three-families share old waste stacks. We handle stack ties and pressure-test before close-up.
